papers.title: Hip dysplasia in patients undergoing total hip arthroplasty in a major centre in New Zealand
papers.abstract: aim: The aim of this study was to determine the absolute number of total hip arthroplasties (THA) performed in a single centre for patients whose pre-operative radiographs demonstrated evidence of hip dysplasia. methods: We retrospectively analysed 317 consecutive primary THA cases at Dunedin Hospital. Pre-operative radiographs were reviewed using standardised measurements: lateral centre-edge angle (LCEA), Tönnis angle (TA), acetabular quotient (AQ) and crossover sign. results: Overall, 21% had dysplastic TA (>10 degrees), increasing to 30% in those <60 years. Severe under-coverage (LCEA <20 degrees) was present in 8% overall and 17% of patients <60, while mild under-coverage (LCEA 20–25 degrees) occurred in 15%. A pathological AQ (<250) was found in 29% of all patients, rising to 38% in those <65 years. Among evaluable radiographs, 18% showed a positive crossover sign, indicating acetabular retroversion. conclusion: Developmental dysplasia of the hip was present in up to one-third of THA patients, over 10 times the rate recorded in the New Zealand Joint Registry. These findings highlight the likelihood of underdiagnosed dysplasia in patients undergoing THA for osteoarthritis. Recognition of subtle dysplastic features, coupled with refined registry coding and potential adjustments to screening policy, may improve early detection and preventative strategies aimed at delaying or avoiding joint replacement.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该文仅统计髋关节发育不良的影像学患病率，与股骨柄应力遮挡、微动或有限元建模无关。
llm.why_not_core: This is a radiographic epidemiology study of acetabular dysplasia prevalence with no femoral stem biomechanics, no stress shielding or micromotion quantification, and no finite element modeling.

summary_zh.motivation: 评估单中心全髋置换患者中髋关节发育不良的实际患病率。
summary_zh.method: 回顾317例初次全髋置换术前X线，测量LCEA、Tönnis角、髋臼商及交叉征。
summary_zh.result: 约三分之一患者存在发育不良征象，远高于关节登记系统记录。
summary_zh.validation: 基于临床影像学回顾性分析。

summary_en.motivation: The study sought to quantify how frequently radiographic signs of developmental dysplasia of the hip appear among patients receiving primary total hip arthroplasty at a single institution.
summary_en.method: Pre-operative radiographs from 317 consecutive primary THA cases were retrospectively assessed using standardized acetabular indices including lateral centre-edge angle, Tönnis angle, acetabular quotient, and crossover sign.
summary_en.result: Dysplastic features were identified in up to one-third of patients, substantially exceeding registry-reported rates and suggesting underdiagnosis.
summary_en.validation: Retrospective clinical radiographic review of consecutive surgical cases.

papers.title: Electrostatic Remodeling of the Plasma Membrane Enables Caveolae-Mediated ZIF8 Delivery for Bone Regeneration.
papers.abstract: Metal-organic frameworks offer powerful platforms for intracellular delivery and tissue regeneration, yet their membrane-level interactions are poorly defined. Here, we show that cationic zeolitic imidazolate framework-8 (ZIF8) remodels the electrostatic landscape of the anionic plasma membrane, triggering caveolae-dependent endocytosis and promoting the intracellular delivery for bone regeneration. ζ-potential analysis and Kelvin probe force microscopy demonstrated that ZIF8 rapidly increased membrane surface electrostatics and induced localized electrostatic polarization at the nanobio interface. Simulations and adsorption kinetics revealed rapid saturation and a strong pH dependence, supporting a charge-dominated adsorption mechanism. Transmission electron microscopy captured sequential uptake events, including caveolae formation, membrane invagination, and lysosomal trafficking. Transcriptomics further identified CAV2-associated endocytosis and mechanosensitive fluid shear-stress pathways as key contributors. On the basis of this mechanism, we constructed an OGP-loaded ZIF8 coating on polyethyleneimine-functionalized titanium implants, enabling intracellular peptide delivery, partial lysosomal escape, enhanced osteogenesis, antioxidant and anti-inflammatory responses, and improved osseointegration in rat bone defect models.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该文聚焦ZIF8纳米颗粒的细胞膜静电重塑与胞内递送机制，仅在钛植入体涂层层面涉及骨再生，与增材制造多孔结构、应力遮挡或LPBF力学测试无直接关联。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not address porous lattice design, stress shielding or stiffness matching, LPBF fabrication, or mechanical/fatigue testing of AM implants; it is a nanocarrier delivery and surface-coating study.

summary_zh.motivation: 金属有机框架的细胞膜层面相互作用机制尚不明确。
summary_zh.method: 结合ζ电位、KPFM、吸附动力学模拟与转录组分析ZIF8的内吞机制，并在钛植入体上构建OGP负载ZIF8涂层。
summary_zh.result: ZIF8经小窝介导内吞实现胞内递送，涂层促进成骨、抗氧化抗炎并改善大鼠骨缺损模型的骨整合。
summary_zh.validation: 体外细胞机制实验结合大鼠骨缺损动物模型验证。

summary_en.motivation: The membrane-level interactions that govern metal-organic framework uptake remain poorly characterized, limiting their rational use in tissue regeneration.
summary_en.method: Cationic ZIF8 was characterized by zeta-potential and Kelvin probe force microscopy, adsorption kinetics and simulations, and transcriptomics, then applied as an OGP-loaded coating on functionalized titanium implants.
summary_en.result: ZIF8 remodeled membrane electrostatics to drive caveolae-dependent endocytosis, and the coated implants enhanced osteogenesis, reduced oxidative and inflammatory responses, and improved osseointegration in rat defects.
summary_en.validation: Mechanistic in vitro cell studies were combined with in vivo evaluation in a rat bone defect model.
